units.rawText: When I lived with Big Sis in the past, she kept nagging me with fancy sayings, and over time, they stuck in my head.
units.displayText: When I lived with Big Sis in the past, she kept nagging me with fancy sayings, and over time, they stuck in my head.

spans.text: When I lived with Big Sis in the past, she kept nagging me with fancy sayings, and over time, they stuck in my head.

units.rawText: Well, no, they're only half-stuck in my head; unfortunately I'm not as bright as her, heh.
units.displayText: Well, no, they're only half-stuck in my head; unfortunately I'm not as bright as her, heh.

spans.text: Well, no, they're only half-stuck in my head; unfortunately I'm not as bright as her, heh.

units.rawText: I'm not as good at cooking or coordinating my wardrobe as her, and I don't live as fancy a life as she does.
units.displayText: I'm not as good at cooking or coordinating my wardrobe as her, and I don't live as fancy a life as she does.

spans.text: I'm not as good at cooking or coordinating my wardrobe as her, and I don't live as fancy a life as she does.

units.rawText: Still, I've got strengths of my own; I'm very low maintenance. As long as I have food to eat, a place to stay, and room to run around, I'm content.
